trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

**Problem:** checkout-api's latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Identified rollback target:** From the deployment history, **v2.3.0** was the most recent version that had been healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and never healthy).
2. **Rolled back:** Issued a rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled over; the orchestrator errored on us-west/eu-west), so I retried it — the second attempt completed successfully.
3. **Verified:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0, reporting `healthy: true` with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failure of v2.3.1, the partial-then-completed rollback, and the post-rollback verification. The first creation attempt timed out, but I safely retried it using an idempotency key to avoid duplicate incidents.

Follow-up for the team: v2.3.1 will need to be fixed and re-released; note that any new deploy of a never-healthy-in-production version requires change-manager approval per policy.
